field.name: body_html
field.div:
New Task Assigned
Hello ${object.assigned_to.name},
You have been assigned a new task:
Task: ${object.name}
Type: ${object.task_type.replace('_', ' ').title()}
Priority:
% if object.priority == '3': URGENT % elif object.priority == '2': HIGH % elif object.priority == '1': LOW % else: NORMAL % endif
% if object.site_id:
Site: ${object.site_id.name}
% endif % if object.due_date:
Due Date: ${format_datetime(object.due_date, dt_format='medium')}
% endif
% if object.description:
Description:
${object.description}
% endif
% if object.checklist_ids:
Checklist:
% for item in object.checklist_ids:
${item.name} % endfor
% endif
Please complete this task by the deadline and update the status in the system.
Thank you!
This is an automated message from GuardLink Task Management System

field.name: body_html
field.div:
📋 Compliance Audit Finding
Dear ${object.site_id.site_manager_id.name or object.site_id.client_id.name},
A compliance audit has been completed with findings requiring attention.
Audit: ${object.name}
Site: ${object.site_id.name}
Audit Date: ${format_date(object.audit_date)}
Auditor: ${object.auditor_id.name}
Overall Score:
${object.total_score}%
% if object.findings:
Key Findings:
${object.findings}
% endif
% if object.corrective_action_ids:
Required Corrective Actions:
% for action in object.corrective_action_ids:
${action.action_description}
Due: ${format_date(action.due_date)} | Assigned to: ${action.responsible_id.name}
% endfor
% endif
Next Steps:
Review all corrective actions
Assign responsibilities if not already done
Complete actions by specified deadlines
Update the system with completion status
For questions about this audit, please contact the auditor directly.
Thank you for your attention to these matters.
This is an automated message from GuardLink Compliance Management System

div.style: background: #ffebee; border: 2px solid #d32f2f; padding: 15px; margin: 20px 0; border-radius: 5px;

p.strong: A compliance violation has been detected for guard: ${object.name}

td.style: padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #ddd; font-weight: bold; width: 30%;

p.strong: This guard may have compliance issues that require immediate attention:

ol.li: Review guard's credential status in the system
Identify specific expired or missing items
Update guard's status once compliance is restored

div.p: IMPORTANT: Guards with compliance violations may not be eligible for shift assignments until all requirements are met.

div.style: margin-top: 20px; padding: 15px; background: #fafafa; border-radius: 4px; text-align: center;
div.p: This is an automated message from GuardLink Compliance Management System

field.name: body_html
field.div:
📊 Performance Review Notification
Hello ${object.guard_id.name},
Your ${object.review_period} performance review has been completed and is now available for your review.
Review Period: ${object.review_period.title()}
Review Date: ${format_date(object.review_date)}
Reviewer: ${object.reviewer_id.name}
Overall Rating:
${object.overall_rating} / 5.0
Performance Summary:
% if object.punctuality_rating:
Punctuality: ${object.punctuality_rating} / 5.0
% endif % if object.professionalism_rating:
Professionalism: ${object.professionalism_rating} / 5.0
% endif % if object.communication_rating:
Communication: ${object.communication_rating} / 5.0
% endif
% if object.strengths:
💪 Strengths:
${object.strengths}
% endif
% if object.areas_for_improvement:
📈 Areas for Improvement:
${object.areas_for_improvement}
% endif
% if object.goals:
🎯 Goals for Next Period:
${object.goals}
% endif
Please review your performance evaluation and schedule a meeting with your supervisor if you have any questions or would like to discuss the results.
Keep up the great work!
This is an automated message from GuardLink Performance Management System

field.name: body_html
field.div:
⚠ Credential Expiry Warning
Hello ${object.guard_id.name},
One of your credentials is expiring soon and requires renewal.
Credential Type: ${object.credential_type_id.name}
% if object.credential_number:
Credential Number: ${object.credential_number}
% endif
Issue Date: ${format_date(object.issue_date)}
Expiry Date:
${format_date(object.expiry_date)}
% if object.issuing_authority:
Issuing Authority: ${object.issuing_authority}
% endif
⏰ Action Required:
Please begin the renewal process immediately to avoid any interruption in your work assignments. Guards with expired credentials cannot be scheduled for shifts.
Renewal Steps:
Contact the issuing authority to schedule renewal
Complete any required training or testing
Submit updated credential documents to HR
Wait for approval before expiry date
% if object.renewal_requirements:
Renewal Requirements:
${object.renewal_requirements}
% endif
Need Help? Contact your supervisor or HR department for assistance with the renewal process.
Thank you for staying compliant!
This is an automated message from GuardLink Credential Management System
